subject.title: [Bug]: Heartbeat / async system events can interrupt and effectively swallow in-progress replies in Telegram topic sessions

question: Should this issue remain the Telegram-topic tracker for heartbeat/system-event lane isolation, or should the remaining stale replay/default-target symptoms move under the broader heartbeat contamination tracker?
rationale: Current main covers the narrow active-reply skip, but the later comments preserve broader Telegram delivery/replay behavior and multiple overlapping open items exist; choosing the canonical owner determines whether a new fix lane is safe or whether maintainers should resolve linked work first.

options.title: Keep This Telegram Tracker
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram topic heartbeat/system-event preemption and require live Telegram-topic proof on the eventual fix.

options.title: Move Under Broader Tracker
options.body: Treat the remaining stale-context/default-isolation work as owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79638 and link this issue as Telegram-specific evidence.

options.title: Resolve Linked PRs First
options.body: Review the open active-reply/no-op suppression candidates before deciding whether this issue still has unique unfixed behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep This Telegram Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue for Telegram topic heartbeat/system-event preemption and require live Telegram-topic proof on the eventual fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the prior active-reply guard resubmission and documented when current main superseded that slice, making them the clearest history-backed owner for the split decision.
